text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali to visit Argentina on March 24-26.
- Ben Ali on Friday received a phone call from Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi congratulating him on the occasion of the Tunisian Independence Day. They also disscussed Maghreb Union issues.
- Tunisia celebrated Youth Day on Friday. It celebrates Water Day on Saturday.
